functions.name: fn_801AB50C
functions.divergence: The corrected Record layout now emits retail's +0x92 outer-state load, +0x8F switch-state loads, and +0x90 timer loads. Explicit no-op cases and retail body order reproduce the initial switch dispatch and the shared case 3/4/6/7 body through the two byte clamps. The first remaining non-branch divergence is the case-5 load order at retail offsets 0x148 and 0x14C: retail loads +0x88 into r4 before +0x8D into r3, while canonical GC/1.3 loads +0x8D into r3 before +0x88 into r4 and lowers the following minimum differently. The later case-1 path first diverges at retail offset 0x1AC, where retail retains handle in r4 while canonical reloads it into r0. Generated fn_801AB50C remains 20 bytes shorter. The former static clamp_u8 was already inlined at both use sites but also emitted as an unused 24-byte out-of-line symbol; spelling the clamps directly removes that extra symbol and is not described as eliminating calls.
